articles.title: Andreeva Fights Back to Beat Sabalenka
articles.summary: Mirra Andreeva came back from 4-1 down to beat world No. 2 Aryna Sabalenka 6-4, 6-0 and reach the last four at the WTA Finals.

articles.title: Play Hide-and-Seek With Airport Sniffer Dogs
articles.summary: The TSA wants volunteers to play hide-and-seek with its sniffer dogs at the airport, and this year's calendar star is Bolt.

articles.title: Hubble Finds a City of Very Old Stars
articles.summary: Hubble has photographed Messier 30, a glittering group of very old stars that may hold clues to how the Milky Way formed.
